title: CAP authentication and authorization
explain: Configure auth strategies and restrict entity/operations by roles/attributes. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "CAP authentication and authorization" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without CAP authentication and authorization, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of CAP authentication and authorization without a failure story
howToApply: Use CAP authentication and authorization explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: NAME IT TO TAME IT: Say “CAP authentication and authorization” + one failure mode out loud — if you can't, you don't own it yet. (CAP → mechanism → failure)
useCases: Discount approval near S/4 — choose placement using CAP authentication and authorization without core mods.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “CAP authentication and authorization” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “CAP authentication and authorization”.
